title: Best Beer Bars in Bruges (2026)
description: Discover Bruges' top beer bars, from hidden historic pubs to bustling breweries. Our guide features local favorites, must-try Belgian beers, and essential insider tips for every visitor.

places.name: De Garre
places.whatToOrder: What to order Tripel van De Garre, served with a complimentary cheese plate.

places.name: Cambrinus
places.whatToOrder: What to order Any beer from their extensive menu; ask for a recommendation based on your preferences. Try a Kwak or a Westmalle Tripel.

places.name: Brouwerij De Halve Maan
places.whatToOrder: What to order A fresh, unpasteurized Brugse Zot Dubbel or Straffe Hendrik Tripel straight from the tap.

places.name: 2be Beer Wall / The Beer Experience
places.whatToOrder: What to order Choose from a vast selection of bottled beers, perhaps a regional lambic or gueuze.

places.name: 't Brugs Beertje
places.whatToOrder: What to order Ask the knowledgeable bartender for a personal recommendation based on your taste.

places.name: Le Trappiste
places.whatToOrder: What to order Any authentic Trappist beer, such as a Westvleteren (if available), Chimay, or Orval.

places.name: Cafe Vlissinghe
places.whatToOrder: What to order A classic local beer like a Rodenbach or a simple Jupiler, and perhaps a croque monsieur.

places.name: The Beer Capital
places.whatToOrder: What to order A tasting flight to sample various styles, or a seasonal Belgian strong ale.

places.name: Comptoir des Coktails et des Bières
places.whatToOrder: What to order Ask for their current craft beer specials on tap, or a unique Belgian IPA.

places.name: Den Anker
places.whatToOrder: What to order A classic Stella Artois or a local Bruges-brewed beer if available, to soak in the local vibe.

places.name: De Kelk
places.whatToOrder: What to order Any of their rotating draft specials, or a robust Belgian Quadruple.

places.name: Rose Red
places.whatToOrder: What to order A regional abbey beer like a Grimbergen Dubbel, or a crisp Belgian white beer.
